Larger common-frame parent stays open: determine actual first-owner sets for all SMLA/QLI keys and group-local slot/C2 readers before eliding non-owner QSL pin/H2D or repeated CPU scalar/setup work. This independent proposal fixes QSL copies; it does not prove every copy necessary, stop owner-qualified QSL elimination, or cap the whole parent at device-only value.
Allocator/temp-lifetime and real plugin-loaded Torch/NPU behavior, graph replay and consumer retirement need actual integration evidence; symbolic poison is control flow, not numerical proof.

Measure unprofiled host/delete cost and request transfer for full balancedC8, original eight-promptC8 and six ordinary loads. Diagnostic host aten envelope includes instrumentation and asynchronous submissions; no new device-kernel reduction measurement.
stopped: Delete first projection or use CPU upper-bound lengths: changes canonical values after speculative rejection.
Delete all builder QSL writes or capture only first QSL owner: native callbacks can retain a different persistent builder address.
Move only canonical writer asynchronously: existing eager copy/derived lengths would read early.
Cache across invocations or skip zero-query QLI task/frontier: violates existing generation/task/lifetime contract.
